title: Lisbon funicular cable snapped before deadly crash, report finds
summary: Investigators say it had not been possible to visually inspect section of cable that separated before incident A cable linking two carriages snapped shortly before Wednesday’s funicular crash in Lisbon that killed 16 people, accident inspectors have said in a report. An operator tried to apply emergency brakes but failed to prevent the derailment, investigators added. Continue reading...
